title: MVP3 · Peg contact and insertion
purpose: Collect matched commands, geometry, relative peg/hole motion and contact loads to compare insertion and jamming under the intended deployment controller.

guided.default_scope_notice: Collection specification only. No insertion fitting, Newton screening, robot motion or transfer validation has run.

minimum_kit: Deployment-path command logger plus joint/TCP and gripper feedback
Qualified synchronized six-axis wrist wrench, with source/frame/tare/compensation recorded
Fixed overview and close side/oblique video views, or another measured peg/hole pose/depth method
Peg and bore gauges appropriate for the actual clearance; measured chamfer/depth, rigid fixture, scale and setup photos
pilot: First check no-contact wrench with the held peg, then one operator-approved centered insertion. Inspect logs and the force/depth evidence before adding offsets or tilt. Never force a jam.

parameters.evidence: As-built peg/bore dimensions at multiple locations, chamfer and depth, fixture and TCP-to-peg transforms, independent depth/relative pose
parameters.limit: Printed hole labels and CAD nominal values are not measurements. Wrong geometry must not be hidden by friction fitting.

parameters.evidence: Wrench-depth-time traces across centered/offset/rate conditions plus known geometry and upstream response
parameters.experiment: I0 through I5; optional material-pair sliding test
parameters.limit: Multi-contact insertion wrench alone generally does not uniquely identify friction; independent normal/tangential load tests may be needed.

parameters.evidence: Synchronized force/moment and local deflection, with known controller compliance, at multiple approved loading rates
parameters.limit: Force versus TCP travel mixes several compliances. Do not call an effective fit a material modulus or independently identified contact stiffness.

parameters.evidence: Physical dimensions, observed contact onset and wrench/pose traces plus simulation convergence tests
parameters.limit: Collision geometry/margins and timestep/iterations are not independently measured by robot logs. Freeze a qualified solver configuration before physical fitting.

trials.motion: Centered nominal insertion and operator-approved withdrawal with the peg pre-grasped
Positive X alignment offset within the reviewed envelope
Negative X alignment offset within the reviewed envelope
Positive Y alignment offset within the reviewed envelope
Negative Y alignment offset within the reviewed envelope
Positive tilt about X within the reviewed envelope
Negative tilt about X within the reviewed envelope
Positive tilt about Y within the reviewed envelope
Negative tilt about Y within the reviewed envelope
Centered insertion at a second operator-approved timing profile
Reserved alignment condition, not used for fitting/model selection
Reserved combined alignment/tilt condition within the approved envelope

conditional_experiments.when: Contact response remains unexplained after geometry/controller/grasp checks
conditional_experiments.collect: Separately reviewed normal load/hold/unload at two loading rates with local deflection and wrench; reserve independent holdouts

conditional_experiments.when: Peg-hole friction is confounded with geometry/compliance
conditional_experiments.collect: Same material/finish pair in a known-normal-load sliding fixture; do not divide insertion axial load by an unknown normal load
New, untouched real trials for baseline and calibrated-simulation-trained policies under a predeclared task protocol and comparable training budgets; these are not fitting trials

metrics_to_record: slip in gripper or fixture motion

reporting.result_source: Actual run records only; collection completeness is not calibration accuracy or transfer proof.

limitations: Do not change a controller to joint-PD merely to fit the MVP1 adapter.
No contact search, force limits, motion offsets or trajectories are automatically approved.
Do not pursue the tightest hole before geometry, fixture and safety checks; one explicitly selected hole per setup revision.
Video/TCP depth without verified rigid grasp and relative geometry cannot alone prove full insertion.
Insertion fitting and package activation are not implemented by this collection recipe.
